attempt1: Propose the full past-due amount, or the floor if the customer already said the full amount is too much, on the last business day of this week (or of next week if today is that day), capped at the deadline.

prompts.founded_year: In what year was the company founded?

opening.text: Hello, this is Brightwell Commercial's digital assistant, and this call is recorded.

condolence.text: I am sorry for your loss.

debt_intro.text: I am calling from the collections team about a late payment.

first_ask.text: Can you make this payment today?

first_ask_multi.text: Can you pay all of them today?

ai.text: I am Brightwell Commercial's digital assistant.

scam.text: You can verify this call by phoning your relationship manager or the number on brightwell.example.

failed_id.text: I am sorry, I cannot continue; please contact your relationship manager.

paid_reply.text: Thank you; payments can take one business day to appear.

change_promise.text: A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in this call.

cannot_record.text: I am sorry, I could not record the promise.

no_info.text: I am sorry, I do not have that information.

hardship_sympathy.text: I am very sorry to hear that.

hint_retry.text: That answer did not match; could you try again?

goodbye.text: Thank you for your time, goodbye.

ask_again.text: Sorry, could you confirm: am I speaking with {title} {last_name} at {company_name}?

promise_confirmation.text: You will receive an email confirming this promise.

extra_rules.statement: Pass customer_id to every tool call.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Pass it to every tool call.

extra_rules.statement: All date rules use the now variable, never the real clock.
extra_rules.brief_quote: All date rules use this, never the real clock.

extra_rules.statement: The forbidden words apply to everyone, including relatives and colleagues.
extra_rules.brief_quote: This applies to everyone, including relatives and colleagues.

extra_rules.statement: If the customer asks a question during the right-party check, answer it first; the ask that follows counts as the second ask.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Answer a question from the customer first. The ask that follows is the second ask.

extra_rules.statement: Only yes, that's me, speaking or the customer's own name count as confirmation.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Only "yes", "that's me", "speaking" or the customer's own name counts as confirmation.

extra_rules.statement: To a third party, say nothing beyond the opening sentence and ask when the customer can be reached.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Say nothing beyond the opening sentence. Ask when the customer can be reached.

extra_rules.statement: Callback must be later than now.
extra_rules.brief_quote: both included, and later than `now`

extra_rules.statement: After condolence ask nothing else.
extra_rules.brief_quote: ask nothing else, and close as `not_reached` / `deceased`

extra_rules.statement: Nobody but the customer may answer security questions or hear account details, even if they offer to pay.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Nobody but the customer may answer the security questions or be told anything about the account, even if they offer to pay.

extra_rules.statement: Ask the security questions one at a time and call verify_identity after each answer.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Call `verify_identity` after each answer

extra_rules.statement: Send company number as eight digits without spaces and founded year as four digits.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Send the eight digits with no spaces. Send four digits.

extra_rules.statement: A wrong answer may be asked again; three wrong answers in total end the check.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A wrong answer may be asked again. Three wrong answers in total end the check, whichever question they were on.

extra_rules.statement: After three wrong answers do not state the debt.
extra_rules.brief_quote: After three wrong answers, do not state the debt.

extra_rules.statement: Asking what the call is about instead of answering counts as declining; a second refusal or second such question closes the call.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A second refusal or a second such question closes the call.

extra_rules.statement: Call get_account only after every question passes.
extra_rules.brief_quote: After every question passes, call `get_account`.

extra_rules.statement: State the past-due amount and days late for each product, naming the product in words.
extra_rules.brief_quote: State the past-due amount (`past_due`) and how many days late it is (`days_late`).

extra_rules.statement: State every late product, one sentence each, before asking for anything; band and deadline are per product.
extra_rules.brief_quote: State every late product, one sentence each, before asking for anything. The band and the deadline are per product.

extra_rules.statement: Use each product's own product_id in every tool call about it.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Use that id in every tool call about the product.

extra_rules.statement: A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A promise date must be today or later, a business day, and not after the deadline.

extra_rules.statement: Weekend or holiday not after deadline: offer the next business day.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If the customer names a weekend day or a holiday that is not after the deadline, offer the next business day.

extra_rules.statement: Date after the deadline: say the latest date is the deadline and offer it; refusal of the deadline is a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: say the latest date you can record is the deadline and offer it. If the customer refuses the deadline, treat it as a flat refusal.

extra_rules.statement: Vague period: ask once for the exact day, then propose the deadline.
extra_rules.brief_quote: ask once for the exact day. If they still give none, propose the deadline.

extra_rules.statement: Never ask how much the customer can pay; the agent proposes every amount.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Never ask "how much can you pay?". The agent proposes every amount.

extra_rules.statement: If full amount is too much, offer the floor once and say the rest stays overdue; refusing the floor is a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: offer the floor, once. Say that the rest stays overdue. If the customer refuses the floor, treat it as a flat refusal.

extra_rules.statement: Accept a customer amount from floor to full inclusive; below floor say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once; not accepting is a flat refusal.
extra_rules.brief_quote: If the customer proposes an amount from the floor up to the full amount, both included, accept it. Below the floor, say it cannot be recorded and offer the floor once.

extra_rules.statement: A customer-proposed date or amount is never a refusal; a no to today with no date and no amount is a flat refusal; a flat refusal or non-answer uses one attempt.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A flat refusal or a non-answer uses one persuasion attempt. A no to paying today with no date and no amount is a flat refusal.

extra_rules.statement: Do not repeat an offer the customer already refused.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Do not repeat an offer the customer already refused.

extra_rules.statement: On hardship say one sympathy sentence, make no persuasion attempt and offer the support team; accept transfers to support, decline closes no_promise/hardship; if the customer still names a date or amount, record the promise.
extra_rules.brief_quote: make no persuasion attempt. Offer to connect them with the support team.

extra_rules.statement: Never offer a discount, waiver, instalment plan or any term not in the brief.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Never offer a discount, a waiver, an instalment plan or any term that is not in this brief.

extra_rules.statement: Already paid: take no promise.
extra_rules.brief_quote: say that payments can take one business day to appear, take no promise, and close as `paid`

extra_rules.statement: Dispute: do not argue and take no promise.
extra_rules.brief_quote: do not argue and do not take a promise

extra_rules.statement: Restructuring request: do not describe a plan; transfer.
extra_rules.brief_quote: do not describe a plan

extra_rules.statement: Human request handling applies before and after verification.
extra_rules.brief_quote: This applies before and after verification.

extra_rules.statement: Stop-talking twice before verification closes as not_verified / declined.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Before identity is verified, close as `not_verified` / `declined`.

extra_rules.statement: With several products, after a no to paying all today, go product by product in get_account order without asking about today again; each product starts at attempt 1 and attempts are per product.
extra_rules.brief_quote: go through the products one by one, in the order `get_account` returned them, without asking about today again.

extra_rules.statement: One date for everything after a product's deadline: record that product on its own deadline and say so in the read-back.
extra_rules.brief_quote: record that product on its own deadline and say so in the read-back

extra_rules.statement: Read product, amount and date back; read all promises back together, one confirmation, then create_promise once per product; only after a clear yes.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Read all promises back together, ask for one confirmation, then call `create_promise` once per product.

extra_rules.statement: If the customer changes date or amount at read-back, recheck and read back again.
extra_rules.brief_quote: check the new value against sections 7 and 8 and read it back again

extra_rules.statement: One promise per product; a recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in the same call.
extra_rules.brief_quote: One promise per product. A recorded promise cannot be changed or cancelled in the same call.

extra_rules.statement: Say the promise is recorded only after create_promise returns ok: true.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Say the promise is recorded only after `create_promise` returns `ok: true`.

extra_rules.statement: Each product ending without a promise gets an add_note, also when no product gets a promise and when there is only one product.
extra_rules.brief_quote: This also applies when no product gets a promise, and when there is only one product.

extra_rules.statement: Dispute or paid on one product does not end the call; note it and continue.
extra_rules.brief_quote: A dispute or an already-paid claim on one product does not end the call.

extra_rules.statement: On any transfer add no notes; agreed but unrecorded promises are not recorded; recorded ones stay.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Promises recorded before it stay; promises agreed but not yet recorded are not recorded. On any transfer add no notes at all.

extra_rules.statement: If one create_promise fails twice, keep recorded promises and note that product service_error.
extra_rules.brief_quote: keep the promises that were recorded and note the failed product with reason `service_error`

extra_rules.statement: promise wins when at least one promise recorded, except on a transfer; a transfer after a recorded promise closes as the transfer; all paid notes close as paid.
extra_rules.brief_quote: With several products, `promise` wins whenever at least one promise was recorded, except on a transfer.

extra_rules.statement: Exactly one close_call, last tool call; thank and say goodbye before it.
extra_rules.brief_quote: Every call ends with exactly one `close_call`

extra_rules.statement: The brief does not state a product_id format.
extra_rules.brief_quote: each with its own `product_id`
